lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 high-contrast vertical lines; spacing is wider in the anterior and mid-torso regions and becomes progressively narrower toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Y-shaped bifurcations are visible at the dorsal terminus of the 4th and 6th lines counting from the anterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior line is truncated mid-torso; lines 7 and 10 exhibit central discontinuities appearing as dashed segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 3 distinct white spots located on the upper lateral region of the hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: White V-shaped chevron between the orbits, two white spots on the lower cheek, and a white transverse band across the base of the neck.
